player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Attic and the Utility room, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to move south from the Attic, which was not a valid move. Next time, I will pay closer attention to the current room and available directions before making a move. If I'm in the Attic and I've already been there before, I will try a new direction, such as going north or trying to go to a different room that I haven't visited yet. If I'm in the Utility room, I will try to go east, but if I've already been there before, I will try a different direction. I will also make sure to keep track of the rooms I've visited to avoid revisiting them unnecessarily.
